content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Roanoke

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to ensure you meet the education and professional-experience thresholds before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Roanoke-based instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours on a flexible schedule, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world project scenarios relevant to local professionals in technology, healthcare, and construction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education, experience, and contact-hour certificate. Pay the PMI examination fee and await application review. Granite PM Academy's team can answer questions about the submission process and documentation requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and strategy sessions, to build confidence before your PMP exam. You'll sit for the computer-based test at a Pearson VUE center in or near Roanoke on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, maintain your certification by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and workshops to help Roanoke professionals keep their credential current and deepen their project-management expertise.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
